The [[Skyrim:Staff of Ehlno Ede|Staff of Ehlno Ede]] is an ancient Ayleid staff bearing a unique enchantment that attacks health, magicka, and stamina simultaneously. It is wielded by the undead Ayleid Lich [[Skyrim:Norion the Undying|Norion the Undying]], and he uses it against you with impunity after you disturb his rest in [[Skyrim:Rielle#Rielle Crypt|Rielle Crypt]] during the quest [[Skyrim:The Cause (quest)|The Cause]]. Once he is defeated, the staff is yours to claim. 
{{NewLeft}}

== Notes ==
*Ehlno Ede means Mortal End in the [[Lore:Ayleidoon|Ayleid language]].

==Bugs==
{{Bug|This staff is not strengthened by Augmented Shock, making it weaker than a staff with only the Wall of Storms effect.|vn=1}}
